title: #186 Robot Teachers
prompt: Some people say robots will work as teachers in school in the future. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Robots are beneficial because they can provide clear and fast instruction, allowing students to practice basic skills many times.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, robots lack human feeling and care, meaning students might feel alone and still need human teachers for support.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, robots lack human feeling and care, meaning students might feel alone and still need human teachers for support.

angles.en: The first body paragraph discusses the positive aspect of using robots in education, focusing on their ability to provide extra practice and support for learning.

angles.label: Point 2

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of robots working as teachers in schools, focusing on their potential to enhance education through technology while addressing concerns about human interaction and emotional intelligence.
outline: advantages of robot teachers: personalized learning and efficiency
disadvantages of robot teachers: lack of emotional intelligence and human connection
keyArguments: Robot teachers can provide personalized learning experiences and efficient instruction.
However, they may lack emotional intelligence and the human connection essential for effective teaching.
